stemMd: Four people sit in a row. Two specified people must sit together. How many orders are possible?
explanationMd: Treat the adjacent pair as a block. The block and the other two people can be ordered in $3!$ ways; the pair can reverse internally in 2 ways. Total 12.

distractorRationale.d: Counts all seatings without enforcing adjacency.
distractorRationale.b: Counts possible adjacent positions without all orders of the others.
